method.city: built share of OSM footprints (4 m raster) per 50 m cell, box-smoothed twice over 250 m; >= 12 % inside the municipality; largest connected piece
method.tiles: 500 m cells whose commercial kernel (r = 300 m, data/ex13/centre.json) reaches >= 500 places/km2 somewhere inside the cell and that touch the city; densest first
method.base: tones by smoothed built share, OSM footprints, OSM parks lighter, every OSM street white
method.aerial: PNOA orthophoto, grayscale, contrast 1.45, brightness 0.82, main OSM streets in white

sources.aerial: PNOA (Plan Nacional de Ortofotografía Aérea), © Instituto Geográfico Nacional — WMS pnoa-ma, CC BY 4.0
sources.streets: OpenStreetMap (43858 ways in the frame), ODbL 1.0
